name: PUBH 5501
title: Foundations of Public Health and Disability
description: Introductory survey of the ways in which disability, both developmental and acquired, is affected by, and interacts with, public health policy and practice. Students will have a foundational understanding of a comprehensive set of issues of both acquired and developmental disability as related to the core elements of public health as framed by the 10 Essential Public Health Services.
requirement_description: Open only to Disability Studies in Public Health certificate students, others by instructor consent.
